title: The checksum selection uses `grep ... | sha256sum -c -`; a pipeline's exit stat…
body: The checksum selection uses `grep ... | sha256sum -c -`; a pipeline's exit status is the last command's, so a non-matching grep (empty stdin) still fails closed because sha256sum -c on empty input exits non-zero. This is correct, but consider `set -o pipefail`-equivalent robustness or an explicit non-empty guard if the grep pattern is ever loosened. Not blocking.
